source_stability.explanation: Unsigned public research ran concurrently with authorized local engineering. It is market/account evidence, not a stable-source native execution qualification.

primary_sources.finding: Position-form default TP/SL tracks full position at trigger; explicitly sized TP/SL is fixed. Parent partial-fill cancellation can cancel children. Stop Limit can rest through a gap.
Wire grouping supports na/normalTpsl/positionTpsl. This schema does not establish a par subminimum Stop Limit exemption or zero-size sentinel semantics.
MinTradeNtl is a documented order error. No tested small-native exemption can be inferred from a historical IOC full close.

questions.question: Position-associated stop can cover 0.0001 BTC?
questions.answer: UNKNOWN on registered par; full-position tracking is documented generally, exact small Stop Limit acceptance/trigger unverified.

questions.question: Sub-$10 native Stop Limit accepted?
questions.answer: UNKNOWN; no actual accepted native Stop Limit record for this account or sampled par users; minimum guard remains.

questions.question: Triggered child closes one-lot residual?
questions.answer: UNKNOWN; no genuine parent/child/fill chain exists.

questions.question: Applicable full-position minimum exception?
questions.answer: Only historical exact 0.0001 BTC reduce-only IOC SELL is independently established; not transferable to native triggers or other markets.

questions.question: Dynamic protective quantity?
questions.answer: Generally documented for default position-form TP/SL, not explicitly fixed size. Pinned production route does not support a verified dynamic-position native wire.

questions.question: Triggered Stop Limit can remain unfilled?
questions.answer: YES; market gap may leave a resting child. Limit is not a guaranteed loss cap.

questions.question: Failed/partial child reconciliation?
questions.answer: Existing manager reads original parent plus exact reported child IDs, actual fills, residual position and open orders; unknown parent/child/cancel blocks a competing IOC. Offline tests only until actual evidence exists.

questions.question: Cleanup after independent take profit?
questions.answer: Existing manager cancels only owned parent/identified children, verifies terminal cancellation/order state and residual position, then requires two flat/zero-order reads. Unknown cancellation blocks any competing close. No actual native cleanup proof yet.

sample.limitation: Bounded samples, not a venue census or proof of prohibition. Two histories reached the 2000-row truncation bound.

historical_exact_ioc_proof.scope: Exact full-position reduce-only IOC SELL only

next_valid_action: New explicitly approved supervised two-lot test only; one-lot partial immediately uses exact approved IOC abort, never an unverified small native stop. No unattended promotion without both actual native-trigger and partial-residual evidence.
